memory_update.text: POWL is the cleanest US-listed underfollowed candidate found in this pass for medium-voltage switchgear and custom electrical distribution exposure tied to AI data centers and electrification.

AMSC should be retained as a niche power-quality/grid-stability candidate rather than a transformer manufacturer; survival depends on evidence that D-VAR and related grid products are growing with electrification demand.

The transformer/switchgear/power-quality node has both hardware-lead-time exposure and interconnection/power-stability exposure; the best funnel should separate transformer OEMs, switchgear/module providers, electrical protection/components and reactive-power/power-quality systems.

Hammond Power Solutions is strongly relevant to dry-type transformers and power-quality products but is primarily Canada-listed/OTC; include in a non-US or OTC shadow pass, not as a core US-listed candidate here.

node: Transformers, switchgear, power quality products, and electrical distribution magnetics
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for direct transformer, switchgear, power-distribution and power-quality exposure. The reference lane is anchored by Eaton as a highly visible diversified electrical leader. The underfollowed lane prioritizes Powell Industries for custom-engineered electrical distribution and medium-voltage switchgear, nVent for electrical connection/protection and newly acquired switchgear/bus-system assets, and AMSC for niche power-quality and grid-stability systems. Hammond Power Solutions appears highly relevant to the node but is primarily Canada-listed/OTC and is therefore treated as a coverage gap rather than a core US-listed candidate in this pass.
